Who we are 
 With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. 
 
 What we need   

 We are looking for a   Fullstack   Engineer   to join our   Cloud Tool and Application Team   within our   Software Engineering organization . Your job will be to design, build, and   maintain   modern cloud-based applications, backend services, and user-facing platforms that support warehouse automation, digital twin, simulation, and robotics operations. You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performance software solutions that power   Symbotic's   next-generation automation systems.   

   

 What we do   

 The   Cloud Tool and Application Team   is part of the   Software Engineering organization , which   is responsible for   building the software platforms, tools, and services that power   Symbotic's   industry-leading warehouse automation solutions. Our team develops cloud-native applications,   monitoring   platforms, digital twin technologies, simulation systems, and operational tools that enable real-time visibility, diagnostics, fleet management, and business-critical engineering workflows across our robotics ecosystem .   

   

 What   you’ll   do   

 Design, develop, and   maintain   modern   fullstack   web applications (React, Next.js), backend services (Node.js), APIs, and cloud-based tools for digital twin and simulation systems.   

 
 Support real-time data visualization, monitoring dashboards, playback tools, diagnostic tools, and operational workflows for robotics and warehouse automation platforms.    

 
 Implement highly secure and scalable data pipelines to ingest data from various sources, ensuring accuracy and timeliness of data used to update digital twin models.   

 
 Manage and optimize cloud-based infrastructure to support digital twin simulations, including storage, computing resources, and network connectivity.   

 
 Collaborate with UX/UI designers, product stakeholders, robotics engineers, cloud engineers, QA engineers, data engineers, and operational users to translate business and technical needs into practical application features.    

 
 Work with cloud infrastructure, databases, messaging systems, and data pipelines to ensure applications are scalable, reliable, secure, and performant.    

 
 Participate in application deployment, CI/CD, production support, troubleshooting, and system performance optimization.    

 
 Support integration with simulation, digital twin, telemetry, diagnostics, fleet management, and AI-powered enterprise automation workflows where needed.    

 
 Maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, API specifications, deployment guides, and operational notes.    

 
 Stay up to date with modern frontend, backend, cloud application, data visualization, security, and AI-assisted development technologies.    

 
 Perform other related duties as reasonably assigned by the direct manager or the Employer.   

 

   

   

 What   you’ll   need   

 2+ years of professional experience in   fullstack   software development, with strong experience across both frontend and backend platforms.    

 
 Strong experience with JavaScript / TypeScript, Node.js, and modern frontend frameworks such as React.js and Next.js.    

 
 Solid experience designing and building scalable backend services, RESTful APIs, real-time services, and cloud-based applications.    

 
 Experience building modern web applications with strong attention to usability, performance, maintainability, and reliability.    

 
 Experience with   frontend   data visualization, dashboard development, or complex web-based user interfaces.    

 
 Experience with web-based 3D rendering or visualization technologies such as   WebGL, Three.js, or   WebGPU   is preferred.    

 
 Experience with data processing pipelines, event-driven systems, real-time data streams, or high-volume telemetry data.    

 
 Familiarity with cloud development and deployment on platforms such as Google Cloud Platform and/or Microsoft Azure.    

 
 Experience working with databases and data platforms such as MongoDB, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, or similar systems.    

 
 Experience with messaging and streaming systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ,   ZeroMQ , NATS, or similar technologies.    

 
 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, deployment automation, monitoring, logging, and modern DevOps practices.    

 
 Plus: Experience with robotics, warehouse automation, digital twin platforms, simulation systems, IoT, telemetry systems, or operational data platforms.    

 
 Plus: Experience supporting AI-powered, data-driven, or enterprise automation workflows.    

 
 Plus: Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar tools.    

 
 Good teamwork, communication, time management, ownership, and problem-solving skills.    

 
 Working   proficiency   in verbal and written English, with the ability to communicate independently in an international environment and clearly present technical concepts, findings, risks, and recommendations to leadership stakeholders.   

 
   


 Our   E nvironment     

 Up to 10% of travel may be   required . Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.   

 
 Employees may   be required   to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued.   

 
   

   


 About Symbotic 
 Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit  www.symbotic.com .
  
 We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. 
 We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information.
